verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own AI agents for screening and transaction monitoring, so a buyer could fairly ask whether those agents can consume tools from external MCP servers; the axis applies. The evidence pack, however, has nothing showing that users can connect MCP servers or extend the agents with external tools. The llms.txt file, docs-md pages and OpenAPI schema only make the docs readable by outside agents, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.
